explanation: The statement concerns the library's own definitions: `machineEllipsoidDimensionSquareRawCode` (a List Bool -> List Bool word-level machine) and membership in `Complexity.FP`, a set of polynomial-time computable word functions defined in the library's own `LeanPool/BeyondBethe/Complexitylib/Classes/P/Defs.lean`, not in Mathlib. Grepping Mathlib for `FP`, `machineCompose`, `RawRat` and polynomial-time machinery in Mathlib/Computability yields nothing relevant (only unrelated tactic metaprogramming names like `NormNum.Result.ofRawRat`). Mathlib has no notion of `FP`/polynomial-time machine closure, so there is no statement to duplicate or instantiate.
